title: Treaty of Spring Wells
text: The Treaty of Spring Wells was an agreement between the United States and the Wyandot, Lenape, Seneca, Shawnee, Miami, Ojibwe, Odawa, and Potawatomi Native Americans, ending the conflict between the U.S. and these Native Americans that was part of the War of 1812. It was signed on September 8, 1815, at the present site of the Fort Wayne historical site in Detroit, Michigan.
